stages.evidence: Empty open hand is initially near its ready pose beside the upright tube.
Empty hand remains in its ready pose throughout this short, truncated episode.
Hand advances toward the tube; other hand remains away from manipulation site.
Fingers descend and position around the upright tube; main/wrist2 provide approach geometry.
Fingers curl around the tube body. This is a truncated enclosure phase, not a claim that the tube was lifted; wrist2 ends early so final portion is supported by main only.

definitions.approach: Move the hand toward a visible object before enclosure or manipulation.
definitions.move: Translate the hand or its held object through free space; do not imply release.
definitions.pick: Acquire and lift an object from its support as a complete pickup action.
definitions.place: Set an object on a support and visibly release it.
definitions.flip: Turn an object over to its opposite face.
definitions.rotate: Change the orientation of a held object through wrist or finger rotation.
definitions.toggle: Change a visible switch between discrete positions.
definitions.open: Open a visible articulated object or container.
definitions.close: Close a visible articulated object or container.
definitions.push: Drive a visible object away by sustained hand contact.
definitions.pull: Draw a visible object toward the hand by contact.
definitions.insert: Feed the shuttlecock tip/body into the tube aperture, inferred from observable relative entry across time.
definitions.press: Depress a visible object or control by contact; not a generic label for occluded fingers.
definitions.click: Actuate a visible button or clicking control.
definitions.strike: Hit a visible object with a brief impact.
definitions.handover: Transfer a visible object between hands or agents.
definitions.rest: An empty hand maintains its resting/ready pose without manipulating an object; a valid posture phase.
definitions.hold: Maintain a continuous grasp and approximately stable support of an already acquired object, including the tube held for the other hand.
definitions.grasp: Close or conform fingers around a visible object; the phase can end before a successful lift, which must not be presumed.
definitions.lift: Raise an enclosed object away from the table/support, with visible upward object motion.
definitions.align: Reposition/orient hand, object or aperture to establish relative alignment; does not assert successful contact or insertion.
definitions.adjust: Visible fine finger, grip or object repositioning around an existing manipulation site; no unseen press or successful insertion is implied.
definitions.retract: Withdraw the hand from the manipulation site without carrying the manipulated object.
definitions.lower: Move the held object downward toward the table; does not assert support contact or release.
definitions.release: Open fingers and separate them from a previously grasped object, using the temporal sequence to verify continued object support elsewhere.
